name: Nehushta
title: Mother of King Jehoiachin
summary: Nehushta, daughter of Elnathan from Jerusalem, was the wife of King Jehoiakim and mother of King Jehoiachin. She was taken into captivity to Babylon along with her son when Jerusalem surrendered.

keyEvents.title: Taken into Captivity to Babylon
keyEvents.description: King Jehoiachin surrendered to the Babylonians together with his mother Nehushta, and they were taken into captivity.
